forum.title: CubeMx(v6.17) Cross Selector Displays MCU Operating Frequency Incorrectly
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@recepsah

This issue has been fixed in the latest version of STM32CubeMX 6.18.0

Download STM32CubeMX6.18.0 from  [here](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubemx.html)

THX

Ghofrane
forum.content_text:
Cross selector displays operation frequency of STM32H743II as 400MHz, but it should be 480MHz. I've refreshed all data and databases but the result is the same. Is there a known solution for this issue?

![recepsah_0-1777898031409.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/c6c98cc0-867c-a1d0-3567-ebad04ab0012.png "recepsah_0-1777898031409.png")
